description: This PHP class implements a value formatting strategy that formats DateTime objects into a time string (hours, minutes, seconds). It belongs to the 'FormatValue' namespace in the 'AccessStrategy' directory of the 'orangehrmMaintenancePlugin'. The class 'FormatWithTime' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface and provides a method to return the time part of a DateTime object.

classes.name: FormatWithTime
classes.description: A class that formats DateTime objects to return only the time component in 'H:i:s' format.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the time part of a DateTime object as a string formatted 'H:i:s', or null if the value is not a DateTime.
